items.title: A dance floor full of friends
items.summary: Student teams filled the floor from the first hour to the last.
items.story:
Teams from across campus took turns holding the floor, trading dance moves and passing along the energy. By the final hour, nobody was sitting down and nobody was counting.

items.summary: Kids and volunteers decorated the windows together.
items.story:
On a quiet afternoon, volunteers brought paint markers and a pile of stencils. By the end of the visit, the whole row of windows was covered in daisies, rockets, and one very large dinosaur.

items.title: Paddles for a Purpose
items.summary: Students and supporters joined together for Paddles for a Purpose!
items.story: Paddles for a Purpose was OttoTHON's first-ever pickleball tournament. Held in a round-robin style competition accompanied by a fun-filled raffle generously donated by our sponsors, we were proud to raise $2,089 in support of Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital!

items.title: Candlelight Vigil
items.story:
The community gathered to honor the lives of the children currently battling pediatric illness and those who have lost their lives to it.

We gathered to honor the children whose lives were taken too soon and to hold their families, loved ones, and memories close to our hearts.

Each candle represents a life that mattered, a story that deserves to be remembered, and a light that will never be forgotten. 

At our Candlelight Vigil we remember, honor, and celebrate the lives of these incredible children.
